title: Exhaustive Canonical Skeletons Generation: A Formal Dataset for Decomposable Symbolic Regression
abstract: arXiv:2610.20108v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural symbolic regression (SR) models require diverse datasets of mathematical expressions for robust training. However, existing datasets rely predominantly on stochastic sampling methods, which suffer from high structural redundancy and incomplete functional coverage. To address this, we introduce an exhaustive dataset of univariate canonical skeletons generated via a deterministic constrained context-free grammar. A canonical skeleton acts as a generic structural representation that subsumes more specific functional forms, eliminating redundant expressions and avoiding repeated computational efforts. Although our dataset consists of univariate skeletons, it is designed to support the decomposable SR paradigm to solve multivariate SR problems without assuming linear separability. translated_title: 穷举式规范骨架生成：面向可分解符号回归的形式化数据集
translated_abstract: 神经符号回归（SR）模型需要多样化的数学表达式数据集以实现稳健训练。然而，现有数据集主要依赖随机采样方法，存在结构冗余度高和函数覆盖不完整的问题。为解决这一问题，我们通过确定性受限上下文无关文法生成了一份穷举式的单变量规范骨架数据集。规范骨架作为一种通用的结构表示，能够涵盖更具体的函数形式，从而消除冗余表达式并避免重复的计算开销。尽管我们的数据集仅由单变量骨架组成，但其设计旨在支持可分解SR范式，从而在无需假设线性可分性的情况下解决多变量SR问题。此外，我们还为该数据集配套了一种采样策略，可生成干净的数值数据，而不会触发数值不稳定性或依赖人工（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出基于确定性受限上下文无关文法穷举生成的单变量规范骨架形式化数据集，消除了符号回归数据集中的结构冗余，并支持在不假设线性可分性的前提下求解多变量符号回归问题。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces an exhaustive dataset of univariate canonical skeletons generated via a deterministic constrained context-free grammar, eliminating structural redundancy in symbolic regression datasets while supporting the decomposable paradigm for solving multivariate symbolic regression without assuming linear separability.
